text: Huge watermelon wedge, tiny raisins: which has more calories?
Yet the wedge holds two hundred eighty-six grams of flesh; sixty raisins, just twenty-eight.
Watermelon is ninety-one percent water, and water has no calories.
Per hundred grams: raisins, two hundred ninety-nine calories; watermelon, thirty.
So a small handful of raisins counts like a whole wedge: log grams, not size.
